messages:
zoe: quick alert - publish for release 2026-03-21.3 failed when pushing to ECR. Manifest referencing layer sha256:9a1f...c4be not found in destination repo.

deploy-bot: publish aborted: 424 Manifest validation error - referenced blob missing in ecr-us-west-2://redwood-staging. Job: https://ci.internal/builds/54321#publish

michael: that layer was present in the builder bucket earlier. Could GC have removed it before the mirror fetched?

zoe: probably. I see the CI upload succeeded but the mirror's HEAD returned 404 during the push. Logs: `HTTP/1.1 404 NoSuchKey` from s3 origin.

audrey: we have a 02:00 UTC change window. Recommend immediate short-term: pin `staging` to previous digest so canaries keep running, then republish in the window.

deploy-bot: action requested: `canary-hold staging` by audrey. Reply with `approve` to lock.

michael: approve. Also open an INFRA hold for prefix `staging/2026-03-21/*` so a repush won't be GC'd while we sign.

infra: created ticket INFRA-5199 to hold lifecycle for that prefix. Note: hold propagation across regions ~5m. If object already deleted we'll need rebuild+reupload.

zoe: fallback plan: retag previous digest to `staging-temp-1751119999`, run full canary on that tag. If republish completes, rotate tags and revoke temp. Make sure to re-run cosign provenance.

security-bot: incident created INC-2026-0436 - staging publish blocked by missing blob. Security oncall notified for attestation re-sign.

audrey: republish checklist for change window: 1) rebuild and upload under new path `staging/2026-03-21/republish-1751119999/` 2) publish with flags `--re-sign --no-cache` 3) wait for security ack (~10m) 4) verify canary 5) rotate staging tag.

deploy-bot: note: tag rotation will trigger `--re-sign` if `--re-sign` not present. Use pipeline flag `--re-sign` explicitly to avoid stale attestations.

michael: I've queued a manual republish plan and assigned to zoe for the run. If mirror worker auth is flaky, infra to patch token refresh (INFRA-5200).

zoe: running diag commands locally:
```
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-builds --key staging/2026-03-21/9a1fc4be.tar
# CLI shows 404 from origin; object missing from origin namespace though CI reports success
```

infra: confirming GC logs now. If deleted, we will coordinate a rebuild path. Also adding spike alert for mirror 4xx rate.

audrey: release notes update: "staging pinned to previous digest due to missing ECR layer; republish scheduled in next change window; temporary tag `staging-temp-1751119999` will be available if needed."

michael: if republish fails in window we abort today's rollout and run postmortem. Add roll-forward criteria: if canary fails for >5m or manifest push fails twice, abort.

zoe: will post back when republish starts. Thanks all.
